name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages Nginx and three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including site configuration, document roots, development certificates, protected site secrets, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, PID and log directory handling, service enablement, and cache service settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python and PostgreSQL, including source checkout, virtual environment and dependencies, database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd service on port 8000.
